method: Editorial scouting estimates calibrated to the owner’s references. Weights describe the agreed future rubric; these scores are not weighted statistical model outputs. coverage: Original CDM/deep-midfield cohort plus historical striker/mixed-forward editorial reviews and a complete summer Forward review queue. Summer Forward is not a certified striker role. Unsupported summer records remain unscored. Winger extension covers the remaining historical attackers classified as wingers, plus the complete summer Winger review queue. Recent unsupported deals remain unscored. CM, CAM, CB, LB, RB and goalkeeper extension reviews 65 additional historical deals. All remaining summer Midfielder, Defender and Goalkeeper records are an evidence queue; broad midfield/defender labels are not guessed into specific roles. Three Neymar records labelled Midfield in the source are outside these requested roles.
